chunks: There is none who could avert it.

key_terms.دَافِعٍ: Averter, one who repels or prevents

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God decrees something, nothing can avert it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of *Al-Hakimiyyah* (Divine Sovereignty), illustrating that God's decree is not merely permissive but actively enforced by His will. It highlights the absolute incapacity of created beings, whether angels, jinn, or humans, to alter divine destiny (*Qadr*), reinforcing the theological principle of *Tawhid* in action.
